book.title: Religious customs in the family: The Radiation of the Liturgy into Christian Homes
book.author: Francis X. Weiser, S.J.
book.publisher: The Liturgical Press, Saint John's Abbey, Collegeville
book.source_role: Author's secondary historical account and contemporary pastoral testimony; not proof of each original tradition or current local use

policy: Source-claim characterization distinguishes reports, anecdote, author suggestions, ritual context and disputed interpretations. Labels are freshly worded factual notes; no substantial source text is reproduced. Historical assertions, especially origins and folk beliefs, require separate evidence.
